Overall, the brands most actively sought by owners for **design-forward or lifestyle-distinctive positioning** in CALA are **Kimpton, Curio Collection, Autograph Collection, Hotel Indigo, Vignette Collection, W Hotels, Tapestry Collection**, and **Soho House** — with **Aman** and **Six Senses** representing the ultra-premium, design-as-philosophy tier.
